The '''Old Galactic Market Concourse Lounges''' were an area of the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] connecting the [[Old Galactic Market Taxi Station|Taxi Station]] and [[Concourse Bazaar]] with the [[Shipping and Receiving Docks]]. The [[Dealer's Den]] Cantina was also located here.
